title: Workspace settings
description: Manage workspace identity, access and lifecycle using server-enforced controls.

general.title: General
general.description: Update the name shown to members and the canonical workspace URL.
general.readOnlyDescription: Only workspace owners and admins can change the name or URL.
general.savedDescription: The workspace identity and canonical URL are up to date.
general.name: Workspace name
general.nameInvalid: Enter a workspace name between 2 and 120 characters.
general.slugHint: Use 3–30 lowercase letters, numbers or internal hyphens.
general.slugInvalid: Enter a valid, available workspace URL.
general.languageHint: Caselog currently provides one consistent English product vocabulary.
general.slugChangeDescription: After a successful change, Caselog redirects this page to the new workspace URL. Existing reserved redirects prevent another workspace from claiming a previous URL.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.description: Destructive workspace actions require explicit owner confirmation.
danger.loadErrorTitle: Unable to load workspace lifecycle settings
danger.ownerOnlyDescription: Admins and other members can review this policy, but only the workspace owner can delete the workspace.
danger.deleteDescription: Deleting {{name}} invalidates every member's access immediately. The workspace then enters a 30-day recovery window before permanent purge.
danger.recoveryDescription: A deleted workspace appears in the workspace selector until its recovery deadline. An owner can restore it there; after the deadline, background purge is irreversible.
